description: This script handles uploading logs and stress test logs to a server, including TLS connection handling, retries, and cleanup. It is used for managing log uploads in a device environment, with specific handling for different device types and protocols.

methods.name: uploadLog
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script name to the specified log file.

methods.name: logTLSError
methods.description: Logs TLS connection errors based on curl error codes.

methods.name: sendTLSSSRRequest
methods.description: Attempts to establish a TLS connection to the SSR server using curl.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Uploads logs via HTTP/HTTPS, with retries and S3 upload handling.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Handles the process of uploading logs during reboot, including packaging and cleanup.
